## README

```markdown
\# Local RAG Assistant

Use command: python chat.py

\## Goal

Build a local AI assistant using:

\- Ollama

\- LangChain

\- ChromaDB

\- Python



\## Models

\- phi3

\- nomic-embed-text



\## Features

\- Read PDF files

\- Store embeddings

\- Answer questions

\- Show document source

\- Show page number

\- Show similarity score



\## Next Goals



\- \[ ] Chat memory

\- \[ ] Conversation history

\- \[ ] Multiple PDFs

\- \[ ] Word documents

\- \[ ] YouTube videos

\- \[ ] Images

\- \[ ] Voice

\- \[ ] GUI

\- \[ ] GitHub deployment



\## Learning Topics



\- Azure AZ-900

\- Networking

\- Cybersecurity

\- IT Support

\- Data Analytics

\- Psychology

\- Tech Interview

```
